subject: Cannot login to dashboard
body: I keep getting access denied after password reset. I need access to my account before the end of the day.
ai_response: Reset the user session and verify recent MFA and access policy changes before re-enabling the account.

subject: Invoice mismatch
body: I was charged twice for the same month. Can someone review the invoice and explain the duplicate charge?
ai_response: Review the billing history and confirm whether a duplicate invoice was generated; if confirmed, issue a credit and notify the customer.

subject: Feature question
body: Can you tell me how to enable exports in the admin portal? I need this for my team reporting.
ai_response: Navigate to Admin Settings > Reporting and enable export permissions for the relevant team role.

subject: Production outage
body: Several users cannot access the workspace and API calls are timing out. This started 20 minutes ago.
ai_response: Escalate to the incident channel, confirm service health, and check recent deployment or dependency failures before restoring access.

subject: Need account downgrade
body: Our plan was updated automatically and we need to move to a lower tier for now. Please help us with the change.
ai_response: Review the subscription change request and confirm the plan downgrade with the billing team before updating the account.
